notes: 所有立绘共用同一段 style_prompt；派生图回喂 master 时只改角色描述，不改风格段。
style_prompt: pixel art character sprite, crisp hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, limited 16-color palette, muted jade green and ink-black tones, full body, standing, facing viewer, neutral expression, plain light warm-gray background, no text, no watermark, no border
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, anti-aliasing, smooth gradients, realistic shading, plastic skin, oversaturated colors, neon, lens flare, heavy glow, text, watermark, signature, logo, multiple characters, cropped limbs, extra fingers, cluttered background
scene_prompt: Chinese xianxia environment concept art, restrained ink-wash painting on toned paper, muted jade-green and ink-gray palette, low saturation, soft diffuse overcast daylight, wide establishing shot, large calm empty sky area, minimal detail, no characters, no text, no watermark
scene_avoid: sunset, orange or golden glow, god rays, saturated sky, photorealistic rendering, 3d cgi look, dense clutter, dramatic lighting, lens flare, people, close-up architecture
